builds.name: Reference: Ranked top core
builds.goal: Reference for Kled: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ top players use most (1,145 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 55.9% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A committed melee scrapper who holds a tether, bursts four attacks and fights for a remount after losing Skaarl. The current top provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Titanic Hydra → Black Cleaver → Overlord's Bloodmail. Conqueror keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Plated Steelcaps, Death's Dance, Guardian Angel.
builds.summary: The proven top baseline: Titanic Hydra → Black Cleaver → Overlord's Bloodmail, with Conqueror.
testPlan: Play it in top as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Titanic Hydra → Black Cleaver → Overlord's Bloodmail) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 55.9% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Titanic Hydra → Black Cleaver → Overlord's Bloodmail.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula:
Kled dashes, dealing [35 / 60 / 85 / 110 / 135 + (0.55) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to enemies he passes through, pulling minions and small monsters towards him.

If this Ability hits an enemy champion or large jungle monster, Kled gains [50]% Move Speed for [1] second(s) and can Recast within [3] seconds to dash back through the same target.

Mounted: Kled throws a bear trap that deals [30 / 55 / 80 / 105 / 130 + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and hooks onto the first enemy champion or large jungle monster hit.

If Kled stays near a hooked enemy for [1.75] seconds, he yanks out the trap, dealing [(30 / 55 / 80 / 105 / 130 + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (2)] physical damage, Pulling them, and Slowing by [(-0.3 / -0.35 / -0.4 / -0.45 / -0.5) × -100]% for [2.5] seconds.

Kled charges toward an area, leaving a trail that grants allies increasing Move Speed. While charging and for 2 seconds after Kled gains up to [200 / 300 / 400 + (3) × AD[statFormula=2]] Shield. Skaarl rams the first enemy champion encountered, dealing [(4 / 6 / 8 + (0.03) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (0.01)] to [(4 / 6 / 8 + (0.03) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (0.03)] max Health magic damage (based on distance travelled) and briefly Knocking Back.

Mounted: Kled's mount Skaarl takes damage instead of Kled. When his Health depletes, Kled dismounts.

Dismounted: Kled replaces {{spell_KledQ_Name}}, gains [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=70, perLevel=5, changes=[])] Move Speed toward enemy champions, and he gains [4 + (0.01) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] bonus Armor and Magic Resist, increased by [30]% for each nearby enemy Champion, up to [(4 + (0.01) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]) × (2.5)]. While dismounted, Kled's attacks deal [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.15, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -0.05000000074505806, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -0.05000000074505806, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -0.05000000074505806, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] reduced damage to Champions. 

Kled gains [15] Courage by Attacking champions, [5] Courage by Attacking epic monsters and structures, and [5] Courage by killing minions. At max Courage Kled remounts with [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.4, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.10000000149011612, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.10000000149011612, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.10000000149011612, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] of Skaarl's Health, once every [30] seconds.

Passive: Kled's next Attack grants [150]% Attack Speed for four Attacks or [4] seconds.

The fourth hit deals an additional [20 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 60] plus [(4.5 / 5 / 5.5 / 6 / 6.5 + (0.02) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.004) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]) × (0.01)] max Health physical damage.

builds.name: Remount attack sprint
builds.summary: Make a saved Violent Tendencies window rebuild Courage quickly.
builds.goal: Make a saved Violent Tendencies window rebuild Courage quickly.
builds.hypothesis: Dismounted attacks grant 15 Courage against champions, while Violent Tendencies supplies 150% attack speed for four attacks and its fourth strike has AD/health-linked percent damage. Blade rewards these actual attacks, Stridebreaker helps contact and Death's Dance may delay lethal damage long enough to remount. Pocket Pistol pellets contribute Courage if they really connect.
testPlan: Required state: Need W ready at dismount, a target reachable and remount's 30-second gate clear.
Measure time from dismount to remount with W available versus already consumed.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Automatic W can be spent on the wave; CC or burst kills Kled before Courage completes.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Four attacks alone do not necessarily reach full Courage; item hits do not grant extra Courage by assumption.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Blade of The Ruined King, Stridebreaker, Hullbreaker, Death's Dance, Sterak's Gage, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Kled: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A committed melee scrapper who holds a tether, bursts four attacks and fights for a remount after losing Skaarl. Fix mounted/dismounted state and W readiness. Compare four-hit burst and remount timing; health attribution to Skaarl and damage before remount must be measured. Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows.
builds.summary: Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Kled: Fix mounted/dismounted state and W readiness. Compare four-hit burst and remount timing; health attribution to Skaarl and damage before remount must be measured.

Start with the early core (Stridebreaker, then matchup armor) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Resource: Courage. Do not treat mana regeneration as Courage recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Kled throws a bear trap that damages and hooks an enemy champion. If shackled for a short duration, the target takes additional physical damage and is yanked toward Kled.

When dismounted, this ability is replaced by Pocket Pistol, a ranged gun blast that knocks back Kled and restores courage. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.

Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Randuin is conditional on the enemy attack/crit profile; it costs an offensive slot.
Full cost 16,100 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Stridebreaker, then matchup armor. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Randuin's Omen, Spirit Visage, Sterak's Gage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Resource: Courage. Do not treat mana regeneration as Courage recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Skaarl health-to-AD bruiser
builds.summary: Test health investment across mounted pressure and dismounted defense.
builds.goal: Test health investment across mounted pressure and dismounted defense.
builds.hypothesis: The current dismounted passive adds defenses through a health-stat expression; W fourth strike also includes AD and health expressions. Bloodmail converts bonus health to AD supporting Q/E and R's large AD-linked shield, while Visage supports received heals and remount recovery only if that recovery qualifies. Cleaver serves repeated physical hits, not R's magic impact.
testPlan: Required state: Need fixed health sources, remount available and accurate mounted/dismounted comparisons.
Measure W fourth hit, dismounted defenses and remount health at fixed bought health.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Buying health can raise the remount target without guaranteeing time to reach it; anti-heal may limit recovery.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: R's percent-health impact is magic despite AD scaling and is not improved by Cleaver's armor shred.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Overlord's Bloodmail, Sundered Sky, Black Cleaver, Spirit Visage, Sterak's Gage, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
